Фонари гасли один за другим — с запада н: The lanterns went out one by one — from west to east. The old folk said: when the Central Beacon goes out, He will come. I did not believe it. Now I hide in the forest, and only two embers are left by the fire.
СЕТЬ МАЯКОВ. Пять ядер света питали её —: THE BEACON NETWORK. Five cores of light powered it — one for each land. While the beacons burned, the Darkness did not dare cross the threshold. The cores are hidden with the guardians of the lands.
Фонарщик из нашей деревни ушёл к Централ: The lamplighter from our village went to the Central Beacon and never came back. They say he left his pickaxe and lantern by the fire. If anyone finds them — know this: the path begins with a single flame.
Вода поднялась за одну ночь. Хранитель г: The water rose in a single night. The Depth Warden is not evil — it is simply lost in the dark, like all of us. The crystals in the mines remember light: shine a beam on them and they will answer.
ВТОРОЕ ЯДРО. Свет можно отражать, но нел: THE SECOND CORE. Light may be reflected, but never given to the Darkness. Whoever gives away their light becomes its shadow.
Дорогая Лина, мы пробили новый штрек. В: Dear Lina, we dug a new drift. In the mirror halls we found strange devices: they hum when light is near. It seems this is not just a mine, but a part of something enormous.
Пепельные пустоши раньше были садами. По: The Ash Wastes used to be gardens. Then came a Fire without light — hot, but blind. It burned what we had no time to shelter.
ТРЕТЬЕ ЯДРО. Страж пепла хранит огонь, ч: THE THIRD CORE. The ash guardian keeps the fire so that it does not devour the world. Do not defeat the fire — tame it.
Дым гасит свет быстрее, чем ветер задува: Smoke puts out light faster than the wind snuffs a candle. I learned to walk along the pits where the ash has cooled. If you are reading this — go north. It is cold there, but bright.
Монастырь замёрз не от холода, а от тиши: The monastery froze not from cold but from silence. The Darkness swept all voices out of it. We hid the prisms so that the light would not leave with us.
ЧЕТВЁРТОЕ ЯДРО. Лёд хранит свет так же,: THE FOURTH CORE. Ice keeps light the way stone keeps memory. The Winter Warden is the last guardian. Defeat it — and the beacon will open the way to the Heart.
Последний фонарщик монастыря сказал: «Ис: The monastery's last lamplighter said: "The Source of Darkness is not a living creature. It is an emptiness that learned to want." He went south, to the Heart, and never returned.
СЕРДЦЕ ТЬМЫ. Здесь стоял первый маяк. Ис: THE HEART OF DARKNESS. The first beacon stood here. The Source devoured its light, and ever since, everything that shines here is a lie.
Не доверяйте огню, который не греет. Не: Do not trust a fire that gives no warmth. Do not believe a light that casts no shadow. True light burns steadily — it is not afraid to be simple.
Если ты читаешь это — ты дошёл. Пятое яд: If you are reading this — you made it. The fifth core is hidden in the Source itself. Awaken the ancient luminaries, direct their light at it — and return the beacons to the world. Forgive us for leaving this burden to you. — The Last Lamplighter
«Я думал, свет погас навсегда. Спасибо,: "I thought the light had gone out forever. Thank you for coming. In the village we will do everything to help you."
"I used to mend the lanterns on the main street. Give me a tool and I will teach you to mend yours too."
«Тени говорили, что Центральный маяк мёр: "The shadows said the Central Beacon was dead. But I saw its little flame from the tower — it still smolders!"
"The last lamplighter walked this road too. He said: to defeat the dark, you must not be afraid of it."
"My grandfather told of five cores of light. He called it the Network. I thought it was a fairy tale..."
«Берегите себя там, наверху. Здесь, в де: "Take care up there. Down here in the village we will wait — and light a candle every evening."
Когда-то над землёй горела Сеть Маяков —: Once the Beacon Network burned over the land — five cores of light that kept the Darkness beyond the threshold.
Потом пришёл Источник Тьмы и погасил Сет: Then the Source of Darkness came and put out the Network. Only the Central Beacon was left — smoldering like the last ember.
Вы — последний фонарщик. Зажгите древние: You are the last lamplighter. Light the ancient lanterns, awaken the cores — and return light to the world.
Пятое ядро света легло в Центральный мая: The fifth core of light settled into the Central Beacon. The ancient network answered — one by one, the beacons lit up across the land.
Волна света прошла по лесам, шахтам, пус: A wave of light swept over the forests, mines, wastes and snows. The Darkness withdrew to where it came from.
В деревне зажгли праздничные огни. Жител: Festival lights were lit in the village. The villagers came out into the streets — for the first time in years without fear.
Но Центральный маяк горит не ради победы: But the Central Beacon does not burn for victory. It burns so that someone watches over it. The lamplighter stayed — because light must always have a keeper.
Спасибо, что вернули свет!: Thank you for bringing the light back!
